name: Creative Path
description: Perfect for writers, marketers, artists, and content creators

lessons.title: Welcome to Creative Prompting
lessons.content: As a creative, you know the power of words. AI is your new creative partner—but only if you can communicate your vision clearly. This course will teach you to craft prompts that bring your ideas to life.
keyPoints: Think of prompts as creative briefs
Specificity doesn't kill creativity—it enables it
Iteration is part of the creative process

lessons.title: Exercise 1: Character Creation
lessons.scenario: You're writing a novel and need to develop a compelling protagonist. Create a character that feels real and multi-dimensional.
lessons.task: Write a prompt that generates a detailed character profile including personality, backstory, motivations, and unique quirks.
lessons.evaluationCriteria: specificity of character details, emotional depth, unique traits
hints: Add backstory elements that explain motivations
Define the character's core conflict or desire

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Tone & Voice
lessons.content: The most important creative decision is voice. AI can match any tone—playful, serious, poetic, conversational—but you need to be specific about what you want.

examples.specific: Write a poetic description of a sunset using metaphors related to music. Tone: melancholic but hopeful. 2-3 sentences.

lessons.title: Exercise 2: Product Story
lessons.scenario: You're a copywriter for a sustainable fashion brand launching recycled ocean plastic sneakers. Create compelling product copy that tells a story.
lessons.task: Write a prompt that generates product copy connecting the customer emotionally to the environmental mission while highlighting the product benefits.
lessons.evaluationCriteria: emotional appeal, storytelling, brand voice consistency, call-to-action

lessons.title: Exercise 3: Social Media Voice
lessons.scenario: A health food startup wants a unique social media voice that stands out. They want to be informative but fun, not preachy.
lessons.task: Write a prompt that creates 3 Instagram captions for a new superfood smoothie bowl, each with a different angle but consistent brand voice.
lessons.evaluationCriteria: consistency of voice, variety of angles, engagement hooks, brand personality
hints: Define the brand personality (witty, warm, knowledgeable?)
Request different content angles (health benefit, lifestyle, taste)

lessons.title: Lesson 3: Show Don't Tell
lessons.content: The golden rule of creative writing applies to prompts too. Instead of saying 'make it exciting,' describe what exciting looks like. Use examples, references, and sensory details.

examples.showing: Write an opening line like Gillian Flynn's 'Gone Girl'—immediate tension, unreliable narrator hint, conversational but unsettling. Reference: 'When I think of my wife, I always think of her head.'

lessons.title: Exercise 4: Email Campaign Series
lessons.scenario: Create a 3-email welcome sequence for new subscribers to a creative writing course. The emails should build anticipation and establish the instructor's voice.
lessons.task: Write a prompt that generates all 3 emails with consistent voice, progressive information reveal, and strong CTAs.
lessons.evaluationCriteria: email sequence logic, voice consistency, progressive engagement, clear CTAs
hints: Define the instructor's voice and teaching style
Outline what each email should accomplish
Specify the transformation story (where they are → where they'll be)

lessons.title: Exercise 5: Blog Post with Style
lessons.scenario: Write a blog post about productivity tips for creative professionals. You want it to sound like Austin Kleon's 'Steal Like an Artist'—practical, visual, inspiring, and slightly rebellious.
lessons.task: Write a prompt that captures a specific author's style and applies it to your topic.
lessons.evaluationCriteria: style matching, reference usage, topic relevance, practical value
hints: Reference specific stylistic elements (short chapters, visual metaphors, rule-breaking)
Request specific examples within the content

lessons.title: Final Challenge: Full Campaign
lessons.scenario: A plant-based protein bar company needs a full content marketing campaign for their new 'Adventure Series' targeting outdoor enthusiasts. Create cohesive content across multiple channels.
lessons.task: Write a comprehensive prompt that generates: 1 blog post, 3 social captions, 1 email, and 2 ad variations—all with consistent brand voice and campaign messaging.
lessons.evaluationCriteria: cross-channel consistency, target audience understanding, campaign cohesion, creative differentiation
hints: Request specific formats for each piece
Include tone variations for different channels
